mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id, m.name, m.path, m.icon, m.sort_no, m.visible, m.status FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.visible = 1 ORDER BY m.sort_no, m.id
SELECT id, parent_id, name, path, icon, sort_no, visible, status FROM sys_menu ORDER BY sort_no, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu(parent_id, name, path, icon, sort_no, visible, status) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{name}, #{path}, #{icon}, #{sortNo}, #{visible}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, role_name, role_code, description, status, create_time FROM sys_role WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id
SELECT menu_id FROM sys_role_menu WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
